policy.purpose: Separate external operational acceptance from ordinary implementation so missing production infrastructure cannot block normal development.
rules: Every graph task with status deferred_final appears exactly once in this queue; no other task appears.
Keep queue order explicit and stable. Do not infer readiness from list position alone.
A deferred task may start only when its start_condition is met and every hard or contract/interface prerequisite is done or appears earlier in this queue.
Every incoming prerequisite must be validated; never bypass an unreviewed or disputed edge.
Queue reason, start_condition and final_stage must exactly match the task-status deferral record.
Deferred tasks remain incomplete and are excluded from completed-task counts.
